a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Teams move people away from unstable structures.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (healer), a healer, prioritizes urgent needs without promising instant recovery.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Children learn what shaking is and where to gather.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child), a frightened child, asks the same question repeatedly and receives patient answers.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Caregivers establish a calm shared sleeping area.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (elder) helps preserve familiar routines amid uncertainty.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Villagers improve evacuation routes and supply storage.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They acknowledge that preparation reduces risk but cannot prevent earthquakes.
